finding: input unavailable and no-card reasons must remain distinguishable
risk: absence could look like low risk
required_control: show explicit test-state and reason in the sandbox trace

finding: patient-view timing is a candidate assumption
risk: panel may arrive before or after the useful moment

finding: clinician may ignore dismiss defer or close
risk: interaction could trigger an unwanted consequence
required_control: no automatic order escalation penalty or repeat suppression

finding: card vocabulary must match the accepted intended-use boundary
risk: screening language could drift into diagnosis
required_control: reuse the bounded Module 01 and Module 02 language

finding: missing stale and inconsistent inputs occur
risk: hidden defaults could create false certainty
required_control: stop evaluation and preserve the unavailable state

finding: limits and nonaction must be visible
risk: users should not have to remember course documentation
required_control: place short limits and ownership in the panel

finding: passive panel avoids a scripted interruption
risk: it may still add attention and documentation work
required_control: count exposure and hidden work separately

finding: only purpose evidence uncertainty and nonaction belong in the first view
risk: extra detail could obscure the boundary
required_control: link detail without crowding the panel

finding: repeat or unresolved cases can occur
risk: users need a safe way to stop or report a defect
required_control: provide pause report and rollback routes in the sandbox

risk: a single English default may exclude users or patients
required_control: test qualified language screen-reader low-vision motor and cognitive-support routes
